import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, pathlib, math
xmlp=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda\data\osm\salvador_osm_map.xml')
root=ET.parse(xmlp).getroot()
nodes={n.attrib['id']:(float(n.attrib['lat']),float(n.attrib['lon'])) for n in root.findall('node')}
ways=[]
for w in root.findall('way'):
 refs=[nd.attrib['ref'] for nd in w.findall('nd') if nd.attrib.get('ref') in nodes]
 tags={t.attrib['k']:t.attrib['v'] for t in w.findall('tag')}
 if refs: ways.append((w.attrib['id'],refs,tags))
target=next(x for x in ways if x[0]=='59224731')
wid,refs,tags=target
pts=[nodes[r] for r in refs]
lat0=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts); lon0=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
R=6378137.0
def xy(lat,lon):
 x=math.radians(lon-lon0)*R*math.cos(math.radians(lat0)); y=math.radians(lat-lat0)*R; return x,y
def centroid(refs):
 pp=[nodes[r] for r in refs]; return sum(p[0] for p in pp)/len(pp),sum(p[1] for p in pp)/len(pp)
def dims(refs):
 q=[xy(*nodes[r]) for r in refs]; return max(x for x,y in q)-min(x for x,y in q),max(y for x,y in q)-min(y for x,y in q)
print('OSM_LACERDA_WAY',wid)
print('TAGS',tags)
print('NODES',len(refs),'CLOSED',refs[0]==refs[-1])
print('CENTER_LATLON',round(lat0,7),round(lon0,7))
print('TARGET_DIMS_M',tuple(round(v,3) for v in dims(refs)))
print('TARGET_POINTS')
for r in refs: print(r,tuple(round(v,7) for v in nodes[r]),tuple(round(v,3) for v in xy(*nodes[r])))
near=[]
for id2,refs2,t2 in ways:
 if id2==wid or not ('building' in t2 or t2.get('man_made') or t2.get('tourism') or t2.get('amenity')): continue
 clat,clon=centroid(refs2); dx,dy=xy(clat,clon); d=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5
 if d<=120:
  dd=dims(refs2)
  near.append((d,id2,t2.get('name',''),t2.get('building',''),t2.get('height',''),t2.get('building:levels',''),dx,dy,dd,t2.get('man_made',''),t2.get('amenity','')))
for row in sorted(near)[:40]:
 print('NEAR','dist=%.2f id=%s name=%r building=%r height=%r levels=%r offset=(%.2f,%.2f) dims=(%.2f,%.2f) man_made=%r amenity=%r'%row)
print('OSM_AUDIT_DONE',len(near))
